title: Professional Certificate Course in Management of Intercultural Communication in Education
description: Master intercultural communication in education. Build understanding, navigate diverse perspectives, and cultivate inclusive learning environments for all.
longDescription: Identify the criteria essential for building Intercultural Understanding. Explain the Onion Model of Culture. Recognize the subconscious elements that influence Intercultural Communication. Analyze the Excel Trademark Method. Define and discuss the concept of Cultural Shock. Evaluate the Blended Approach to Intercultural Understanding. Demystify cultural communication in educational settings. Explore frameworks like the Onion Model and Excel Trademark Method, recognize subconscious influences, navigate cultural shock, and discover the Blended Approach to foster global competence. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: Learn to identify key criteria, apply the Onion Model of Culture, and analyze the Excel Trademark Method. Delve into recognizing subconscious influences, defining Cultural Shock, and evaluating the effectiveness of the Blended Approach for fostering intercultural understanding.
